claims.text: Monitor + correct fat-soluble vitamin (A, D, E, K) deficits; calcium + vit D supp w periodic bone density screening.
claims.quote: Fat-soluble vitamin deficiencies (A, D, E, K) should be monitored and corrected, and patients should receive calcium and vitamin D supplementation along with periodic bone density screening to mitigate the risk of osteoporosis from chronic cholestasis.
